commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Implement Phase 4: Tool Integration for Skills System

- Add four AI tool methods to ReliasAssistantChatClient:
  - InvokeSkillAsync: Execute skill operations with JSON parameters
  - GetAvailableSkillsAsync: List all available skills
  - GetSkillOperationsAsync: Get operations for a specific skill
  - GetSkillInstructionsAsync: Retrieve skill SKILL.md content

- Wire up DI in Program.cs:
  - Add InitializeSkillServicesAsync method for skill service creation
  - Create SkillDiscoveryService -> SkillCatalogService -> SkillInvocationService chain
  - Update ServiceContainer with SkillInvocation property
  - Pass skill service to CreateChatClient

- Add logger extensions (EventIds 700-704) for skill tool operations

- Add 18 unit tests in ChatClientSkillToolTests.cs covering:
  - Service unavailable scenarios
  - Parameter validation
  - Success/failure/timeout cases
  - Skill and operation discovery

- Update SKILL-PLAN.md to v1.5.0 documenting Phase 4 completion

All 243 tests passing.

commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Implement Phase 3: Skill Invocation Service

Add SkillInvocationService with full parameter mapping and context generation:

- ISkillInvocationService interface with InvokeAsync, GetSkillInstructionsAsync,
  GetSkillOperationsAsync, and GenerateSkillContextAsync methods
- SkillInvocationService implementation with:
  - Skill validation (existence, enabled state, operation lookup)
  - PowerShell command building with proper argument escaping
  - Timeout handling and execution result conversion
  - AI context generation for enabled skills
- SkillExecutionResult model with Success, Output, Error, ExitCode,
  ExecutionTime, TimedOut properties and factory methods
- SkillParameter model with ToPowerShellArgument() for parameter formatting
- 8 new logger extension methods (EventIds 200-207) for invocation tracking
- 13 unit tests covering success, failure, timeout, and parameter scenarios

Update SKILL-PLAN.md to v1.4.0 marking Phase 3 complete with 225 tests passing

commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Implement Phase 2 Skills Infrastructure

Add complete skill discovery, parsing, and catalog services:

- Skill model classes (Skill, SkillMetadata, SkillScript, SkillAuthType, SkillPlatform)
- SkillMetadataParser for YAML frontmatter extraction from SKILL.md files
- ISkillDiscoveryService interface and implementation for scanning skill directories
- SkillValidationResult for structural validation (SKILL.md required, scripts optional)
- ISkillCatalogService interface and implementation for skill management
- Skills configuration section in appsettings.json
- SkillsLoggerExtensions for CA1848-compliant structured logging
- 32 comprehensive unit tests (all passing)

Phase 2 is now complete per SKILL-PLAN.md v1.3.0.
